sources.name: sheet-h
sources.prompt: Exactly 1536x1024 pixels, a truly transparent background (transparent_background=true): no backdrop, no shadow field, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no frames. Eight separate small objects laid out in a strict grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centred in its own 384x512 cell with wide empty transparent gutters, never touching or overlapping, all the same visual size (each about 230px across), same soft top-left light. Painted in EXACTLY the same cozy hand-painted watercolour storybook style as the attached reference sheet of icons (fine warm-brown outlines, matte painted colour planes, soft shading): simple, readable silhouettes that still read at 28px. Row 1, left to right: a friendly small cartoon hand with a light warm skin tone and a short cream sleeve cuff, index finger extended pointing straight up and slightly left, other fingers curled, seen from the back, like a game tutorial pointer; a small sprig of pink cherry blossoms with two green leaves (spring); one bright yellow sunflower head with two leaves (summer); one red-orange maple leaf (autumn). Row 2: one pale blue-white snowflake crystal with soft painted edges (winter); a small wooden hourglass with golden sand running down; a small grey-blue rain cloud with three falling raindrops; a small gift box wrapped in red paper with a cream ribbon bow.

processing: Each cell cut from its sheet left to right, top to bottom (scratch tool cut-icon, as for 2026-11-24): its halo cleaned (alpha above 235 kept, a 5px min and max filter, a 1.2px blur), cropped to the opaque box, fitted in 128x128 and saved as assets/art/ui/<cell>.png; pnpm run assets:webp makes src/art/ui/<cell>.webp.
